name: reset achievements
description: Reset achievements data for selected or named (online or offline) character. Achievements for persistance progress data like completed quests/etc re-filled at reset. Achievements for events like kills/casts/etc will lost.

name: reset all
description: Request reset spells or talents (including talents for all character's pets if any) at next login each existed character.

name: reset honor
description: Reset all honor data for targeted character.

name: reset items
description: bags

name: reset items all
description: Delete all items in the selected player's inventory (equipped, in bags, in bank, in keyring, in currency list and in vendor buy back tab).

name: reset items allbags
description: Delete all items in the selected player's inventory including the bags themselves.

name: reset items bags
description: Delete all items in the selected player's bags.

name: reset items bank
description: Delete all items in the selected player's bank.

name: reset items currency
description: Delete all items in the selected player's currencies list.

name: reset items equipped
description: Delete all items equipped on the target player.

name: reset items keyring
description: Delete all items in the selected player's keyring.

name: reset items vendor_buyback
description: Delete all items in the selected player's vendor buyback tab.

name: reset level
description: Reset level to 1 including reset stats and talents. Equipped items with greater level requirement can be lost.

name: reset spells
description: Removes all non-original spells from spellbook. . Playername can be name of offline character.

name: reset stats
description: Resets(recalculate) all stats of the targeted player to their original VALUESat current level.

name: reset talents
description: Removes all talents of the targeted player or pet or named player Playername can be name of offline character. With player talents also will be reset talents for all character's pets if any.

name: reset
description: Type .reset to see the list of possible subcommands or .help reset $subcommand to see info on subcommands

name: respawn
description: Respawn target creature and GO without waiting for respawn time expiration. If no target provided, respawn all nearest creatures.

name: respawn all
description: Respawn all nearest creatures and gameobjects without waiting for respawn time expiration. Also forces respawn of all pending spawn group respawns on the current map.

name: revive
description: Revive the selected player. If no player is selected, it will revive you.

name: save
description: Saves your character.

name: saveall
description: Save all characters in game.

name: send
description: Type .send to see a list of possible subcommands or .help send $subcommand to see info on the subcommand.

name: send items
description: Send a mail to a player. Subject and mail text must be in "". If for itemid not provided related count values then expected 1, if count > max items in stack then items will be send in required amount stacks. All stacks amount in mail limited to 12.

name: send mail
description: Send a mail to a player. Subject and mail text must be in "".

name: send message
description: Send screen message to player from ADMINISTRATOR. Will return an error if player is offline (can be problematic with SOAP for example)!

name: send money
description: Send mail with money to a player. Subject and mail text must be in "". Money can be specified as a raw copper amount (e.g.1000) or as a currency string usingg/s/c suffixes for gold/silver/copper (e.g.1g2s3c,5g,50s).

name: server corpses
description: Triggering corpses expire check in world.

name: server debug
description: Shows detailed information about the server setup, useful when reporting a bug.

name: server exit
description: Terminate worldserver NOW. Exit code 0.

name: server idlerestart cancel
description: Cancel the restart/shutdown timer if any.

name: server idlerestart
description: Restart the server after #delay seconds if no active connections are present (no players). Use #exit_code to change the exit code, default = 2.

name: server idleshutdown cancel
description: Cancel the restart/shutdown timer if any.

name: server idleshutdown
description: Shut the server down after #delay seconds if no active connections are present (no players). Use #exit_code to change the exit code, default = 0.

name: server info
description: Display server version and the number of connected players.

name: server motd
description: Show server Message of the day.

name: server restart cancel
description: Cancel the restart/shutdown timer if any.

name: server restart
description: Restart the server after #delay seconds. Use #exit_code to change the exit code, default = 2.

name: server set closed
description: Sets whether the world accepts new client connectsions.

name: server set difftime
description: $time (in milliseconds) update time diff is written to the log file.

name: server set loglevel
description: $facility can take the values: appender (a) or logger (l). $loglevel can take the values: disabled (0), trace (1), debug (2), info (3), warn (4), error (5) or fatal (6)

name: server set motd
description: Set server Message of the day for the specified $realmId. If $realmId is not provided it will update for the current realm. Use $realmId -1 to set motd for all realms.

name: server shutdown cancel
description: Cancel the restart/shutdown timer if any.

name: server shutdown
description: Shut the server down after #delay seconds. Use #exit_code to change the exit code, default = 0.

name: server togglequerylog
description: Toggle SQL query log on/off.

name: server
description: Type .server to see the list of possible subcommands or .help server $subcommand to see info on subcommands

name: settings
description: Type .settings to see the list of all available commands.

name: settings announcer
description: Disables receiving announcements. Valid announcement types are: 'autobroadcast', 'arena', 'bg', 'pvpstart' and 'pvpall'.

name: setskill
description: Set a skill of id #skill with a current skill value of #level and a maximum value of #max (or equal current maximum if not provide) for the selected character. If no character is selected, you learn the skill.

name: showarea
description: Reveal the area of #areaid to the selected character. If no character is selected, reveal this area to you.

name: skirmish
description: [arena] can be "all" or comma-separated list of possible arenas (NA,BE,RL,DS,RV). [XvX] can be 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 5v5. After [XvX] specify enough nicknames for that mode.

name: spect
description: Type .spect to see the list of possible subcommands or .help spect $subcommand to see info on subcommands.

name: spect leave
description: Leave arena spectator.

name: spect reset
description: Reset arena spectator.

name: spect spectate
description: Start arena spectator, watch #playername.

name: spect version
description: Check spectator addon version.

name: spect watch
description: Watch #playername.

name: spellinfo
description: Type .spellinfo to see a list of subcommands or .help spellinfo $subcommand to see info on subcommands.

name: spellinfo all
description: Displays all available data for spell #spellid including attributes, general properties, effects and targets.

name: spellinfo attributes
description: Displays basic info and attribute flags for spell #spellid including SpellAttr0-7, custom attributes, stances, dispel type and mechanic.

name: spellinfo effects
description: Displays effect data for spell #spellid including effect type, aura type, base points, multipliers, misc values, mechanic, trigger spell, amplitude and class mask per effect.

name: spellinfo targets
description: Displays target data for spell #spellid including target mask, creature type, max affected targets, and per-effect TargetA, TargetB, radius and chain targets.

name: string
description: Display a server string by its ID and optional locale.

name: summon
description: Teleport the given character to you. Character can be offline.

name: teleport add
description: Add current your position to .teleport command target locations list with name $name.

name: teleport del
description: Remove location with name $name for .teleport command locations list.

name: teleport group
description: Teleport a selected player and his group members to a given location.

name: teleport name
description: Teleport the given character to a given location. Character can be offline. To teleport to homebind, set #location to "$home" (without quotes).

name: teleport name npc guid
description: Teleport the given character to creature with spawn id #creatureSpawnId. Character can be offline.

name: teleport name npc id
description: Teleport the given character to first found creature with id #creatureId. Character can be offline.

name: teleport name npc name
description: Teleport the given character to first found creature with name (must match exactly) #creatureName. Character can be offline.

name: teleport
description: Teleport player to a given location.

name: ticket assign
description: Assigns the specified ticket to the specified Game Master.

name: ticket close
description: Closes the specified ticket. Does not delete permanently.

name: ticket closedlist
description: Displays a list of closed GM tickets.

name: ticket comment
description: Allows the adding or modifying of a comment to the specified ticket.

name: ticket complete
description: Mark a ticket of the given ID as complete.

name: ticket delete
description: Deletes the specified ticket permanently. Ticket must be closed first.

name: ticket escalate
description: Place the specified ticket in the escalation queue.

name: ticket escalatedlist
description: Show all tickets in the escalation queue.

name: ticket list
description: Displays a list of open GM tickets.

name: ticket onlinelist
description: Displays a list of open GM tickets whose owner is online.

name: ticket reset
description: Removes all closed tickets and resets the counter, if no pending open tickets are existing.

name: ticket response
description: Type .ticket response to see the list of possible subcommands or .help ticket response $subcommand to see info on subcommands.

name: ticket response append
description: Append response to the specified ticket (without newline).

name: ticket response appendln
description: Append response to the specified ticket (with newline).

name: ticket response delete
description: Delete a response from a ticket.

name: ticket response show
description: Show a response for a ticket.

name: ticket togglesystem
description: Toggle ticket system on/off.

name: ticket unassign
description: Unassigns the specified ticket from the current assigned Game Master.

name: ticket viewid
description: Returns details about specified ticket. Ticket must be open and not deleted.

name: ticket viewname
description: Returns details about specified ticket. Ticket must be open and not deleted.

name: ticket
description: Type .ticket to see the list of possible subcommands or .help ticket $subcommand to see info on subcommands

name: titles
description: Type .titles to see the list of possible subcommands or .help titles $subcommand to see info on subcommands.

name: titles add
description: Add title #title (id or shift-link) to known titles list for selected player.

name: titles current
description: Set title #title (id or shift-link) as current selected titl for selected player. If title not in known title list for player then it will be added to list.

name: titles remove
description: Remove title #title (id or shift-link) from known titles list for selected player.

name: titles set
description: Type .titles set to see the list of possible subcommands or .help titles set $subcommand to see info on subcommands.

name: titles set mask
description: Allows user to use all titles from #mask. #mask=0 disables the title-choose-field

name: unaura
description: Remove aura due to spell #spellid from the selected Unit.

name: unban account
description: Unban accounts for account name pattern.

name: unban character
description: Unban accounts for character name pattern.

name: unban ip
description: Unban accounts for IP pattern.

name: unban playeraccount
description: Unban the account that owns the character having the designated character name.

name: unban
description: Type .unban to see the list of possible subcommands or .help unban $subcommand to see info on subcommands

name: unbindsight
description: Removes bound vision. Cannot be used while currently possessing a target.

name: unfreeze
description: "Unfreezes" #player and enables his chat again. When using this without #name it will unfreeze your target.

name: unlearn
description: Unlearn for selected player a spell #spell. If 'all' provided then all ranks unlearned.

name: unmute
description: Restore chat messaging for any character from account of character $playerName (or selected). Character can be ofline.

name: unpossess
description: If you are possessed, unpossesses yourself; otherwise unpossesses current possessed target.

name: unstuck
description: Teleports specified player to specified location. Default location is player's current hearth location.

name: wchange
description: Set current weather to #weathertype with an intensity of #grade.#weathertype can be 0 for fine, 1 for rain, 2 for snow, 3 for storm, 86 for thunders, 90 for blackrain.#grade is a float value from 0.0 (disabled) to 1.0 (maximum intensity).'

name: whispers
description: Enable/disable accepting whispers by GM from players. By default use worldserver.conf setting.

name: worldstate scourgeinvasion battleswon
description: Adjusts the Scourge Invasion battles won count by (can be negative).

name: worldstate scourgeinvasion show
description: Displays the current status of the Scourge Invasion.

name: worldstate scourgeinvasion startzone
description: Starts a Scourge Invasion event in the zone specified by . Valid zone IDs: 0-7.

name: worldstate scourgeinvasion state
description: Sets the Scourge Invasion state. Valid values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled.

name: worldstate sunsreach counter
description: Sets a Suns Reach worldstate counter and displays current Suns Reach status.

name: worldstate sunsreach gate
description: Sets the phase of Sunwell Plateau Gate. Valid values: 0 = All Gates Closed, 1 = Gate 1 Agamath Open, 2 = Gate 2 Rohendar Open, 3 = Gate 3 Archonisus Open.

name: worldstate sunsreach gatecounter
description: Sets a Sunwell gate progression counter and displays current Suns Reach gate status.

name: worldstate sunsreach phase
description: Sets the phase of Sun's Reach. Valid values: 0 = Staging Area, 1 = Sanctum, 2 = Armory, 3 = Harbor.

name: worldstate sunsreach status
description: Displays current Suns Reach and Sunwell gate progression status.

name: worldstate sunsreach subphase
description: Sets the subphase mask of Sun's Reach. Valid values: 1 = Portal, 2 = Anvil, 4 = Alchemy Lab, 8 = Monument, 15 = All.

name: wp
description: Type .wp to see a list of possible subcommands or .help wp $subcommand to see info on the subcommand.

name: wp add
description: Add a waypoint for the selected creature at your current position.

name: wp event
description: Type .path event to see the list of possible subcommands or .help path event $subcommand to see info on subcommands.

name: wp load
description: Load pathid number for selected creature. Creature must have no waypoint data.

name: wp modify
description: Changes the value actionaction_chance Changes the value action_chancedel Deletes a selected waypointdelay Changes the value delaymove Moves a selected waypointmove_flag Changes the value move_flag

name: wp reload
description: Load path changes ingame - IMPORTANT: must be applied first for new paths before .wp load #pathid

name: wp show
syntax: .wp show $optionOptions:on $pathid (or selected creature with loaded path)
description: Show visual waypoints (Note: You must have GM on to see the waypoints)off Hide the visual waypoints.info Shows info for selected waypoint.first Shows visual the first waypoint.last Shows visual the last waypoint.

name: wp unload
description: Unload path for selected creature.

name: wpgps
description: Output current position to sql developer log as partial SQL query to be used in pathing
